verdicts.reason: A scrambles the SALE sequence (E sits above the headline, then S-A-L), the circular badges are lost, the letters are loose and tiny, and there is a large dead gap plus a cramped, unreadable cluster at the bottom, so it is unusable. B keeps the headline on top and rebuilds the four SALE circles in a column with the tassel, which is recognisably the original. But the letter sizes vary (S and E large, A and L small), the lantern art is duplicated and tiny, and there is dead space in the middle.
